explanation: Keep the current level's nodes, output their values, then collect their nonnull children as the next level.
spaceComplexity: O(w) auxiliary space for maximum level width w, excluding output.
attribution: Original EPI Practice C# implementation, reusing and refining the repository-authored Blind75 algorithm fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
correctness: The current list contains exactly all nodes at one depth, in left-to-right order. Outputting their values creates that depth’s correct row. Collecting each node’s left child before its right child produces exactly the next depth in order, establishing the invariant for the next iteration.
walkthrough: For [7,3,11,null,5,9], the first frontier is [7], then [3,11], then [5,9]. Return [[7],[3,11],[5,9]]. Missing children contribute no entries.
edgeCases: An empty tree returns no rows.
A singleton tree returns one one-value row.
Null positions are omitted rather than included as values.
